title: Shared rumours reach the party, and coin edges add up
summary: Several small money fixes from the November audit: rumours shared in party chat now reach everyone in a shared room, and merchant warnings, loans and smith prices match what is actually paid.
items: Share in party chat on a bought rumour now sends it to everyone in a shared room, not only to your own screen.
A merchant's "can't afford" warning now uses the price you are paid, including market events, faction standing and a town's sale cap.
Loans, repayments and exchange trades add coins on top of the ones you hold: platinum and electrum are no longer changed into gold.
A repayment you cannot afford now says so, instead of mentioning the coin limit.
Smith prices with a decimal multiplier are exact: 90 cp of labour at ×1.1 is 99 cp, not 100.
A DM coin edit above the largest supported balance (10,000,000,000 gp) is refused, so downtime keeps working.
Deleting a pooled item or a character on a device also removes its open treasure-pool claims, as in a shared room.
